name: Xsnow
description:
Xsnow is a festive, animated desktop holiday toy for X11. It brings gently falling snowflakes, blowing snowdrifts, festive trees, and Santa flying in his reindeer-pulled sleigh to your desktop workspace.

Features:
- Gently falling snowflakes that accumulate as snowdrifts on top of open desktop windows
- Flying Santa Claus in a sleigh pulled by reindeer across the screen
- Festive evergreen trees, playful penguins, and customizable winter scenery
- Configurable snow speed, snowflake count, wind velocity, and Santa flight frequency
- Compatible with modern compositing managers and multiple monitor setups
